summary: The LLM landscape in 2026 is dominated by ChatGPT/GPT-5 from OpenAI with ~55.5% of consumer web traffic, though its lead is narrowing as Gemini surges to 25.6% and Claude climbs to 9.3% market share. Enterprise API usage tells a different story, with Anthropic capturing ~40% of enterprise spend versus OpenAI's 27%, while open-source models like DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Llama 4, and Qwen3 have closed the gap with frontier proprietary models and now command serious developer adoption through HuggingFace and self-hosted deployments. Aggregator reach across AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, and IBM watsonx has become a decisive factor in enterprise adoption, amplifying models beyond their direct-API numbers.

models.name: GPT-5
models.popularity_notes: ChatGPT holds ~55.5% of global generative AI web visits as of August 2026 (Similarweb), and OpenAI leads LLM API market share; GPT-5 is available on Azure OpenAI Service, AWS Bedrock, and Snowflake Cortex, massively amplifying enterprise reach beyond direct API consumption.
strengths: Broadest ecosystem and third-party integrations
Strong multi-step reasoning and conversational dialogue
Massive aggregator coverage across Azure, AWS, Snowflake, and IBM watsonx
General-purpose excellence across coding, writing, and analysis
Largest developer mindshare and community
models.best_for: General-purpose enterprise and consumer AI applications requiring broad compatibility and ecosystem support

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Gemini's web traffic grew ~450% year-over-year to 2.9 billion visits in May 2026 (Similarweb), reaching 25.6% market share by August 2026, and it is natively available on Google Vertex AI and increasingly on AWS Bedrock, giving it massive enterprise aggregator reach.
strengths: Best-in-class long context handling up to 1M tokens
Native multimodal capabilities across text, image, video, and audio
Deep Google ecosystem integration including Workspace and Search
Available natively on Google Vertex AI with enterprise SLAs
Fastest growing market share of any major LLM in 2025-2026
models.best_for: Long-document analysis, multimodal enterprise workflows, and teams embedded in the Google Cloud ecosystem

models.name: Claude Opus 5 / Claude Fable 5.1
models.popularity_notes: Claude holds ~9.3% of consumer web market share and ~40% of enterprise API spend per Menlo Ventures 2025 data, making it the dominant model in enterprise API revenue; Claude is available on AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI, significantly multiplying its enterprise footprint.
strengths: Leads enterprise API revenue with ~40% share among large organizations
Top scores on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
Strong safety and reliability profile preferred by regulated industries
Available on AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI for secure enterprise deployment
Exceptional performance on complex reasoning and long-form writing
models.best_for: Enterprise applications in regulated industries requiring safety, compliance, and high-quality reasoning

models.name: Llama 4
models.popularity_notes: Llama 4 is the most downloaded open-weight model family on HuggingFace in 2026, widely adopted for self-hosted and on-premise deployments, and available through AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, and IBM watsonx, giving it unmatched aggregator breadth among open-source models.
strengths: Largest open-weight model community with millions of HuggingFace downloads
Available across all major cloud aggregators including AWS, Azure, GCP, and IBM watsonx
No licensing cost for self-hosted deployments
Strong general reasoning benchmark performance close to frontier models
Highly customizable via fine-tuning for domain-specific applications
models.best_for: Organizations requiring self-hosted or on-premise deployment with no per-token licensing costs

models.name: DeepSeek-V4-Pro / DeepSeek-V3
models.popularity_notes: DeepSeek led OpenRouter API usage with 24.4% of text requests in the week of September 21, 2026, and holds 3.4% of consumer web market share; its open-weight availability and exceptional cost efficiency have driven massive developer adoption, with DeepSeek-V4-Pro topping multiple open-source benchmarks including SWE-bench and LiveCodeBench.
strengths: Leads OpenRouter API marketplace with 24.4% of text request share
Top open-source model for coding and bug-fixing on Onyx Open LLM Leaderboard
Developed at fraction of typical LLM training cost, enabling aggressive pricing
Strong reasoning capabilities competitive with frontier proprietary models
Available as open weights for fully self-hosted deployment
models.best_for: Cost-sensitive developers and enterprises needing high-performance coding and reasoning at minimal API cost

models.name: Qwen3 / Qwen3-235B
models.popularity_notes: The Qwen family has been adopted by over 90,000 enterprises globally, Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking redefined the open-weights landscape with trillion-parameter scale and 119-language support, and Qwen models rank among the top HuggingFace downloads consistently in 2026.
strengths: Adopted by over 90,000 enterprises across consumer electronics, gaming, and more
Best multilingual coverage with support for 119 languages
Trillion-parameter scale at open-weights availability
Consistently high download counts on HuggingFace
Strong performance on coding generation benchmarks
models.best_for: Multilingual enterprise applications and Asian market deployments requiring open-weight flexibility

models.name: Grok-3 / Grok-4
models.popularity_notes: Grok holds approximately 2.4% of consumer web market share as of August 2026 (Similarweb) with deep integration into the X platform providing unique real-time data access; Grok-4.1 Fast offers an exceptionally large 2M token context window at $0.20 per million input tokens, driving API developer experimentation.
strengths: Largest context window among major commercial models at 2M tokens
Real-time information access via X platform integration
Extremely competitive pricing at $0.20 per million input tokens
Strong benchmark performance on reasoning tasks
Witty and direct conversational style favored by developers
models.best_for: Applications requiring real-time web data, ultra-long context processing, or cost-optimized high-volume API usage

models.name: Mistral Large
models.popularity_notes: Mistral Large is ranked among the best open-source LLMs in 2026 for speed and efficiency, is available on AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, and IBM watsonx giving it strong enterprise aggregator coverage, and the Mistral model family consistently ranks among the most downloaded on HuggingFace.
strengths: Available across AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, and IBM watsonx
Best-in-class inference speed relative to model size
Strong European regulatory compliance and data residency options
Efficient architecture requiring less compute for equivalent output quality
Active open-source community with broad fine-tuning support
models.best_for: Latency-sensitive applications and European enterprises requiring GDPR-compliant AI deployments

models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.popularity_notes: GPT-6 Astra leads frontier model benchmarks in math, reasoning, and cybersecurity tasks per Artificial Analysis data as of September 2026, and inherits OpenAI's full aggregator distribution across Azure OpenAI Service, AWS Bedrock, and Snowflake Cortex for enterprise reach.
strengths: Leads hardest math, reasoning, and cybersecurity benchmarks among all models
Available through full Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, and Snowflake Cortex enterprise infrastructure
Highest capability ceiling for frontier research and agentic tasks
Strong tool use and multi-step agent orchestration
Enterprise-grade safety and compliance certifications
models.best_for: Cutting-edge research, advanced agentic workflows, and enterprise tasks requiring maximum reasoning capability

models.name: Microsoft Phi-4
models.popularity_notes: Phi-4 is recognized as a top open-source LLM for high-performance reasoning in small-scale deployments in 2026, benefits from native integration across Azure AI and GitHub Copilot infrastructure, and its small parameter count drives strong HuggingFace download numbers among developers optimizing for edge and on-device use.
strengths: Best reasoning performance per parameter count among small language models
Extremely low cost at $0.07 per million input tokens
Native integration with Azure AI and GitHub Copilot ecosystem
Suitable for edge and on-device deployment due to small footprint
Strong benchmark results on STEM reasoning tasks relative to model size
models.best_for: Edge deployment, cost-constrained high-volume inference, and on-device AI applications requiring strong reasoning in small form factor
